outcome_definitions.ground_truth_verified: AXIOM selected PyMigBench's target and the final patch passed differential verification.
outcome_definitions.verified_alternative: AXIOM selected a different target for the same source and the final patch passed verification; this is not automatically a better migration.
outcome_definitions.verified_incidental_migration: A verified change affected a different source role in the same file and is not credited to this benchmark pair.
outcome_definitions.environment_incomplete: The historical component-level base/target environment or required verifier tooling could not be reproduced; not accepted as success.
outcome_definitions.target_infeasible: The verifier explicitly excluded PyMigBench's target as structurally incompatible with the source role; this is not inferred from an installation conflict.
outcome_definitions.verification_rejected: A selected migration failed a deterministic verifier guard or retry budget; not accepted as success.

result_category_definitions.pymigbench_exact_verified: AXIOM produced and verified the same target migration recorded by PyMigBench.
result_category_definitions.verified_alternative: AXIOM verified a different target for the same source role. Its alternative_efficiency record states whether real comparable measurements justify an efficiency-superior claim.
result_category_definitions.rejected_after_repair_budget: A selected migration remained unaccepted after the globally bounded verifier repair budget was exhausted.
result_category_definitions.not_verified_or_not_adjudicated: No verified migration claim is made. category_reason and detailed outcome distinguish no-change, environment, resolver, provider, and other causes.

evidence_definitions.repair_history: Structured verifier feedback for each real repair cycle; route identifies the repair agent asked to act.
evidence_definitions.profiler_evidence: Whitelisted import/memory values and runtime-probe result/provenance. Only runtime probes with status 'measured' count toward runtime coverage; unsupported, timeout, and failed probes are retained as explicit statuses.
evidence_definitions.environment_plan: Read-only historical-environment plan. It records the selected compatible local Python or explicit interpreter diagnostics; target_version='auto' means planning did not invent or fetch a pin. Candidate Security may later record an exact selected target under target_releases and resolved_target_version.
